contract: construct() -> list of edges [u, v] of a simple graph on vertices 0..49 that is triangle-free and has diameter at most two (every pair adjacent or with a common neighbour). Minimize the maximum degree; the optimum is 7.
notes: The Moore bound forces maximum degree at least 7 on 50 vertices, and the Hoffman-Singleton graph attains it, so 7 is optimal. Exact local certificates are not Lean proofs. Consult the independent oracle and malformed-input tests.
